update.title: Scheduled display warmth and bedtime reminders
update.summary: Built Night Mode to run display warmth and bedtime reminders from one overnight schedule and one configuration.

preview.description: Night Mode settings panel showing a 6500K current temperature and Warmer Now, Normal Now, and Auto controls.

blocks.body:
## Coordinate the overnight schedule

I built Night Mode around explicit blue-light, bedtime, and wake times. The service handles schedules that cross midnight, starts `wlsunset` with the configured day and night temperatures, and keeps the overnight behavior in one place.

## Keep reminders on the same timeline

The configuration also holds the blue-light message, bedtime warning offset, and bedtime message. Bringing those values together makes the complete display-and-reminder sequence easy to read and adjust.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Day[Normal display] -->|blue-light start| Warm[Warm display]
  Warm --> Warning[Bedtime warning]
  Warning --> Bedtime[Bedtime reminder]
  Bedtime -->|wake time| Day
blocks.description: The configured overnight window connects display warmth and reminders in one sequence.

blocks.code:
[schedule]
blue_light_start = "00:00"
bedtime = "02:00"
wake_time = "10:00"
transition_minutes = 5

[temperature]
day = 6500
night = 3000

[notifications]
enabled = true
blue_light_message = "Blue light filter activated - winding down"
bedtime_message = "Bedtime! Time to wrap up and rest"
bedtime_warning_minutes = 15
blocks.description: The configuration keeps the overnight window, target temperatures, and notification timing together.
